# 💬 Description
**DitheringLib** — Library mod with common code for other mods, that also works with dithering effects. 

This library is required for the proper synchronization and compatibility of these specific mods with one another. This also includes quick bug fixes across all mods and a more convenient mod development.

# 📃 Known Mods
- [**Entity Dithering**](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-dithering) — LopyMine
- [**Item Dithering**](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-dithering) — LopyMine
- [**Particle Dithering**](https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-dithering) — LopyMine
